newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share mood better, but brittle.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share mood better, but brittle.

text.p: Sentiment in the Singapore share market improved on Monday morning after Friday's sharp sell-off, but it was unclear whether prices would start dropping again in the afternoon, dealers said.
"It's sideways with limited movement, although the tone is better this morning," said one.
Dealers said they did not see funds taking large positions ahead of a widely expected interest rate increase when the US Federal Reserve met on Tuesday.
At 0156 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index rose 4.76 points to 2,073.24.

"Blue chips are going to remain weak after disappointing results and Singapore non-oil exports figures in the last two months suggest the economy might not do as well this year as last year," another dealer said.

Keppel Corp fell again, down Singapore $0.10 to S$9.10 on 1.18 million units on a bleak shiprepair outlook. Jurong Shipyard's share price would be cushioned by a takeover bid at S$6.80, despite poor results reported on Saturday, dealers said.
Dairy Farm saw 3.006 million shares crossed at US$0.763 and US$0.764. Market volume was 29 million shares with 95 losers against 47 gainers.
